description: This file defines an abstract interface 'NotesService' and two implementations: 'LocalStorageNotesService' for client-side storage and 'ApiNotesService' for server-side API communication. It also includes utility functions and a provider function to select the appropriate service based on environment configuration. The class structures suggest a focus on managing notes, tags, and folders within a note-taking application.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for note management operations, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting notes, and managing tags and folders.

classes.name: LocalStorageNotesService
classes.description: Concrete implementation of NotesService that persists data in browser's localStorage, supporting CRUD operations for notes, tags, folders, and tag/folder assignment.

classes.name: ApiNotesService
classes.description: Concrete implementation of NotesService that interacts with a REST API to perform CRUD operations and management of notes, tags, and folders.

methods.name: abstract listNotes(): Observable<Note[]>; listNotes
methods.description: Returns an observable of notes ordered by last updated date descending.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Fetches a single note by ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional initial properties.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with provided changes.

methods.name: listTags
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all tags.

methods.name: upsertTag
methods.description: Creates or updates a tag with the specified name.

methods.name: listFolders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all folders.

methods.name: upsertFolder
methods.description: Creates or updates a folder with the specified name.

methods.name: moveToFolder
methods.description: Assigns or removes a note from a folder.

methods.name: toggleTag
methods.description: Associates or disassociates a tag with a note.

methods.name: export function provideNotesService(): NotesService { provideNotesService
methods.description: Factory function to provide the appropriate NotesService implementation based on environment configuration.
